title: Should the canon-conformant trendline fitter (v2) replace the in-process fitter inside backtest/lib/filters.py::detect_trendline_rejection_bearish at the 2026-10-30 checkpoint?
frozen_by: Opus, executing markdown/0dte/KEY-LEVELS-CHART-READING-HANDOFF.md section 9.5 row F item 2
freeze_proof: This file's first commit timestamp. v2 DID NOT EXIST when this rule was written -- WS-C was still building it in a parallel agent. There is therefore no first-look to disclose and no way for the rule below to have been fitted to a result.
classification: SHAPE CHANGE, not a risk reduction. Swapping the fitter changes WHICH entries fire, in both directions and by an unknown amount. Under the config freeze this is a 2026-10-30 item and is explicitly NOT eligible for the 2026-09-29 safety checkpoint, which admits pre-registered kill-type risk REDUCTIONS only.

what_is_being_swapped.incumbent: backtest/lib/filters.py::detect_trendline_rejection_bearish (:758-870) -- fitted in-process per tick: pivot HIGHS only, descending only, lookback_bars=60, min_swings=3, proximity_pct=0.0010, require_decreasing=True. This is the ONLY trendline that gates an entry anywhere in the system; every drawn line on the chart is decoration relative to it (work order section 9.1).
what_is_being_swapped.challenger: the canon-conformant fitter WS-C is building -- per section 9.9 this is an EXTENSION of backtest/lib/trendline_detector.py, not a new parallel module: ATR-scaled touch tolerance, closes-through disqualifying (not merely score-penalised), DRAFT/CONFIRMED split, premarket bars 04:00-09:30 ET admitted, parallel channel/wedge rail, support-may-descend via require_slope=any.
what_is_being_swapped.not_in_scope: detect_trendline_reclaim_bullish (:1101) stays SHADOW under every outcome of this prereg. Nothing here touches heartbeat_core gating, params*.json, exit logic, or sizing.

populations.window: the 40-day scored window ending at the 2026-10-30 checkpoint
populations.arms: the real-fills arms only (safe-2, bold-2, safe-3, risky-1). Sim/BS-priced rows are ranking-only and may never decide this (L50/L71: real-fills is the only WR authority).
populations.in_sample_note: Every session on or before 2026-09-09 is an IN-SAMPLE PRIOR. It is reported honestly alongside the decision and never used to gate it. The decision reads forward sessions only.
populations.counterfactual_construction: v2-gated entries are produced by replaying the SAME sessions with only the fitter swapped -- every other gate, filter, sizing rule and exit rule held byte-identical. If a replay cannot hold everything else identical, this prereg is UNDECIDABLE and v1 stays (see decision_rule.DEFAULT).

metric_definition.primary: day-level bootstrap Profit Factor, 2.5th-percentile CI lower bound, computed by setup/scripts/go_live_gate.py::statistical_criterion() -- REUSED VERBATIM, not reimplemented (L251). That function already evaluates all three of as-traded, ex-best-day (single largest contributing day dropped) and cost-adjusted.
metric_definition.headline_gate_from_the_work_order: ex-best-day PF is the named bar: if v2-gated entries on the 40-day window are not >= v1 on ex-best-day PF, v1 stays (work order section 9.5 row F item 2).
metric_definition.why_ex_best_day_is_the_bar: C4/C24: this codebase's recurring failure is a result carried by one exceptional session. A fitter change that only wins with its best day included has not been shown to change anything.
metric_definition.wr_is_not_a_bar: Win rate is a DIAGNOSTIC here, reported but never decisive. The validated engine is a low-WR right-tail (CLAUDE.md go-live gate rationale); a WR bar would measure a strategy shape this project already killed.

decision_rule.ACT_swap_v2_into_filters: ALL of: (a) n >= n_min on BOTH variants; (b) v2 ex-best-day PF CI-lower >= v1 ex-best-day PF CI-lower; (c) v2 does not regress the immutable J-edge anchor trades (OP-16 anti-regression -- re-score the anchors, winners must not turn into losses or non-entries); (d) v2 advantage is not concentrated in a single day or a single arm (drop-best-day AND drop-best-arm both survive); (e) the WS-C reproduction ledger passed its own bar (>=80 percent of J hand-drawn lines reproduced within 1x tolerance on anchor and 10 percent on slope, AND the cyan 5iZLKB touch-x3 line NOT reproduced).
decision_rule.DEFAULT: v1 STAYS. This prereg is written so that silence, ambiguity, an undecidable replay, or a missing WS-C ledger all resolve to NO SWAP. The incumbent does not have to win; the challenger has to.
decision_rule.no_partial_swap: v2 either replaces the fitter for the bear detector or it does not. No per-arm, per-regime or per-time-of-day carve-outs -- those are new hypotheses needing their own preregs (C15: gates interact multiplicatively).

anti_gaming_clauses: No re-reading of the decision before 2026-10-30. An interim look does not void the prereg but MUST be logged in this file as an amendment with its date, per the freeze convention.

No tuning v2 parameters after seeing the gated-entry result. The v2 parameter set is frozen by the WS-C reproduction ledger BEFORE this comparison runs; if a parameter is changed afterward, this prereg is void and a new one is required.
If the v2 result looks extraordinary (large PF lift, sudden clean win), run the /fable-too-good protocol BEFORE reporting: hunt the artifact first. Suspicion scales with how good it looks.
The chart-drawing work (WS-A/B/E) is NOT evidence for this prereg in any direction. Drawing what the engine trades changes visibility, not entries.
revert_line: git revert <the swap commit>. The swap is a single call-site change inside detect_trendline_rejection_bearish; v1 fitter code is not deleted by this prereg under any outcome, so revert is one commit and restores byte-identical behaviour.
guard_required_before_swap: a RED-proofed regression test pinning the incumbent behaviour on the anchor sessions, so that a future accidental change to the fitter fails loudly (C35: built+tested != shipped; graduated guards live in backtest/tests/test_graduated_guards.py).
invocation_note: Any 10-30 application runs with GAMMA_FREEZE_OVERRIDE in the invocation, per the freeze protocol.

disclosure_OP20.N: TBD at read time -- both variant entry counts and scored-day counts are reported, never just the winner.
disclosure_OP20.IS_vs_OOS: sessions on or before 2026-09-09 are in-sample prior and reported separately; the decision reads forward sessions only.
disclosure_OP20.null_baseline: v1 as-is on the identical replayed sessions -- a paired comparison, not a comparison against no-trading.
disclosure_OP20.known_confounds: SPY price-space edge is not option-space edge (L74/C3): a fitter that improves line quality in price space can still lose in premium space through delta/theta/stop-misfire. The comparison is therefore run on OPTION P&L from real fills, never on SPY-price outcomes.

amendments.type: INTERIM_LOOK_IN_SAMPLE_PRIOR_ONLY -- does not void the prereg, logged per anti_gaming_clauses[0]
amendments.trigger: J pushback 2026-09-10 ('why would nothing you did touch the trading?') -- work order item to score the fitter swap on TRADE OUTCOME, not line-reproduction fidelity.
amendments.what_ran: harness-level (no filters.py/heartbeat_core.py edit, no GAMMA_FREEZE_OVERRIDE) paired replay of v1 vs v2 on the 45 real-fill trendline_rejection engine entries across the 4 real-fills arms, 2026-07-02..2026-09-08 (all IN-SAMPLE PRIOR, all before this prereg's forward window opens). statistical_criterion() from go_live_gate.py reused verbatim.
amendments.result_summary: v2 fired on 0 of 45 real-fill bars (0 of 16 harness-verified-reproduced bars). v1 as-traded/ex-best-day/cost-adjusted PF CI-lower = 0.257/0.167/0.254 (fails its own >1.0 bar too, on this narrow single-trigger slice). v2 = insufficient_data (n=0), cannot be priced on real option P&L by construction. All 5 ACT_swap_v2_into_filters clauses (a)-(e) fail independently -> KILL_v1_stays, DEFAULT holds. Separate v1-only lookback_bars/min_swings/proximity_pct sensitivity sweep (own N, not conflated with this verdict): no cell clears a material bar over production defaults; no new prereg warranted.
amendments.forward_window_status: NOT STARTED -- the prereg's 40-day scored window ends 2026-10-30 and has not begun as of this amendment's date. This amendment is a disclosed in-sample look, not the forward decision. The decision_rule and DEFAULT above are UNCHANGED by this amendment.
